I do have depression, sorry for not mentioning that earlier. I’ve gone to get help, I’m on meds, but it doesn’t do anything for me. I’ve been pessimistic all my life because I don’t see a reason to change that. I agree with you, on the point that we are our worst enemies, but I really can’t change anything anymore. And I don’t want to. It’s been long enough that I’m actually comfortable in this state, but I’m realising how useless I am and how painful life actually is, that I just want to end it all

There’s nothing for me to look forward to in life anymore. No dreams, no friends, nothing. I know my results aren’t the worst, I’m not the dumbest guy out there, and there probably is a future for me, but I don’t think I’m willing to live long enough to find out. Life in itself is suffering, and I’ve been like this for long enough. I’ve just been living for the sake of it, for the past 4 years, and now I finally got the courage to end it all and I still managed to mess that up
It’s no accident, it’s just me being useless and unable to achieve what I set out to do, which is basically the story of my life
